description: This file defines the 'BuzzLikeOnComment' entity class, representing a 'like' interaction on a comment within the OrangeHRM system. It includes ORM mappings, properties for related comment and employee entities, and methods for accessing and manipulating these properties.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a 'like' action on a comment in the OrangeHRM system, including fields for ID, associated comment, employee who liked, and the timestamp of the like.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this like record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this like record.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment entity associated with this like.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Associates a comment entity with this like.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the employee who liked the comment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this like.

methods.name: getLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Gets the timestamp when the like was made, in UTC.

methods.name: setLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the like to the current UTC time.
